name: shadcn-for-muten
style: shadcn zinc dark (tokens shipped by globals.css: bg-card / bg-primary / text-muted-foreground / border-border / …)

components.name: card
components.description: A surface with CardHeader / CardTitle / CardDescription / CardContent / CardFooter sub-components.

components.name: badge
components.description: A small status descriptor. variant: default | secondary | destructive | outline.

components.name: alert
components.description: A callout with AlertTitle / AlertDescription. variant: default | destructive.

components.name: avatar
components.description: A user's initials in a circle (AvatarFallback).

components.name: switch
components.description: A toggle; the page owns the bool + the action.

components.name: spinner
components.description: A loading indicator (animate-spin loader).

components.name: progress
components.description: A determinate progress bar; value is 0-100.

components.name: separator
components.description: A thin divider line.

components.name: empty
components.description: An empty-state placeholder (title + description in a dashed border).

components.name: breadcrumb
components.description: A breadcrumb trail with BreadcrumbLink / BreadcrumbSeparator / BreadcrumbPage.

components.name: pagination
components.description: Page navigation with PaginationLink / Previous / Next / Ellipsis.

components.name: field
components.description: A labelled form control: FieldLabel / FieldDescription / FieldError.

components.name: item
components.description: A bordered row: ItemContent / ItemTitle / ItemDescription.

components.name: checkbox
components.description: A checkbox; the page owns the bool + the toggle action.

components.name: toggle
components.description: A two-state button; the page owns the bool + the toggle action.

components.name: toggle-group
components.description: Single-select toolbar with ToggleGroupItem; page owns a text state.

components.name: radio-group
components.description: Single choice with RadioGroupItem; page owns a text state.

components.name: collapsible
components.description: A trigger + content shown when open; page owns the bool.

components.name: accordion
components.description: Stacked expandable sections with AccordionItem; page owns a bool per item.

components.name: tabs
components.description: Tab bar (TabsList/TabsTrigger) + TabsContent panels; page owns the active-tab text.

components.name: dialog
components.description: A modal with DialogTitle/Description/Footer; page owns the open bool. Backdrop click closes.

components.name: tooltip
components.description: A hover tooltip (pure CSS, no state). The slot is the trigger.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.description: A menu below a trigger with DropdownItem/Label/Separator; page owns the open bool.

components.name: popover
components.description: A floating panel below a trigger; page owns the open bool.

components.name: alert-dialog
components.description: A modal requiring an explicit choice (no backdrop dismiss); page owns the open bool.

components.name: sheet
components.description: A panel that slides in from the right; page owns the open bool.

components.name: drawer
components.description: A panel that slides up from the bottom; page owns the open bool.

components.name: hover-card
components.description: Richer content shown on hover (pure CSS, no state).

components.name: select
components.description: A value picker with SelectItem; page owns the value text + open bool.

components.name: scroll-area
components.description: A scrollable region with styled scrollbars.

components.name: message
components.description: Chat Message + Bubble + Marker (variant: sent | received).

components.name: message-scroller
components.description: A scrollable column of chat messages.

components.name: attachment
components.description: A file attachment chip (icon + name + size).

components.name: menubar
components.description: A bar of menus (File/Edit/View); page owns which is open via a text state.

components.name: navigation-menu
components.description: A nav bar with hover-revealed panels (pure CSS, no state).

components.name: combobox
components.description: A Select with a search box; page filters items with `each … where`.

components.name: command
components.description: A command palette (search + grouped CommandItem list).

components.name: slider
components.description: A draggable range slider (Custom). Page owns the value number.

components.name: input-otp
components.description: N single-character boxes synced to one value (Custom). Page owns the value text.

components.name: calendar
components.description: A month-grid date picker (Custom). Page owns the selected ISO date text.

components.name: toaster
components.description: Fixed toast notifications (Custom). Page bumps a trigger counter to fire one.

components.name: carousel
components.description: A slide carousel over a list (Custom). Page owns the slides list.

components.name: chart
components.description: An SVG bar chart over a list of { label, value } (Custom).

components.name: gradient-blinds
components.description: Animated WebGL gradient + diagonal-blinds hero background that follows the cursor and fades into the page (needs ogl).

components.name: resizable
components.description: Two panels with a draggable splitter (Custom).

components.name: context-menu
components.description: Right-click an area to open a menu of items (Custom).

components.name: number-field
components.description: A numeric input with -/+ steppers, min/max/step (Custom).

components.name: segmented-control
components.description: A single-select toolbar (SegmentedItem); page owns a text state.

components.name: file-input
components.description: A click/drag-drop file dropzone (Custom); emits file names.

components.name: color-picker
components.description: A swatch + saturation/value + hue popover (Custom); page owns the hex.

components.name: vector-field
components.description: Paired NumberFields (X/Y) for position or size.

components.name: tree-view
components.description: A nested folder/file tree (Custom): expandable, selectable, icons + indent.

components.name: toolbar
components.description: A grouped button bar with ToolbarGroup / ToolbarSeparator.

components.name: canvas-viewport
components.description: A <canvas> with pan/zoom (Custom) + a muten toolbar slot floating on top.

components.name: status-bar
components.description: A thin bottom bar with StatusItem / StatusSpacer.

components.name: zoom-control
components.description: A - 100% + zoom widget; page owns the zoom number.

components.name: split-button
components.description: A main action + a caret dropdown; page owns the open bool.

components.name: tag-input
components.description: Chips you add by typing + Enter (Custom); page owns a comma-joined text.

components.name: swatch
components.description: A grid of selectable color swatches (Swatch); page owns the selected hex + colors.

components.name: range-slider
components.description: A two-thumb range slider (Custom); page owns the low + high numbers.

components.name: sidebar
components.description: AppSidebar - a collapsible nav panel (SidebarHeader / SidebarGroup / SidebarItem). Named AppSidebar so it never shadows muten's core Sidebar <aside> primitive.

components.name: sortable-list
components.description: Drag rows to reorder (Custom); page owns a comma-joined order.

components.name: inspector
components.description: Property grid: InspectorSection (collapsible) / InspectorRow (label : value slot).

components.name: folder-picker
components.description: Connect a local folder via showDirectoryPicker (Custom); emits the name.

components.name: command-palette
components.description: A top-anchored modal holding a Command; page owns the open bool.

components.name: hotkey
components.description: A global keyboard shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl+key), invisible (Custom).

components.name: code
components.description: Syntax-highlighted code block that understands muten (shared highlight.js, same grammar as the VS Code extension).

components.name: stepper
components.description: Horizontal or vertical step progress indicator; done steps show a check, the current step is ringed (parts: Stepper, StepperVertical, Step).

components.name: timeline
components.description: Vertical event timeline: a dot on a connector line + title/time/description per item (parts: Timeline, TimelineItem).

components.name: pill
components.description: A hero eyebrow chip (rounded-full, bigger than Badge); slot-based for an icon + text.

components.name: feature-grid
components.description: BLOCK: responsive grid of feature cards (icon + title + copy). Parts: FeatureGrid, FeatureCard.

components.name: pricing
components.description: BLOCK: a row of pricing tiers (name/price/features/CTA), featured highlight. Parts: Pricing, PricingTier, PricingFeature.

components.name: logo-cloud
components.description: BLOCK: a 'trusted by' strip of logos, muted + grayscale until hover. Parts: LogoCloud, LogoCloudItem.

components.name: count-up
components.description: Animate a formatted number (2.4M / 94% / 40ms / 99.99%) from 0 when it scrolls into view; lands on the exact target. Custom. Styled form (takes the class): `Custom CountUp inputs(to: "2.4M") class("text-4xl font-bold")`. For stat bands + hero metrics.

classComponents.note: Size/spacing-driven primitives ship as classes in globals.css (no `muten add` needed once you @import it). Style the muten primitive with these:
classComponents.button: Button "Save" -> save class("btn btn-default")   (variants: btn-default|btn-secondary|btn-outline|btn-ghost|btn-destructive|btn-link · sizes: btn-sm|btn-lg|btn-icon)
classComponents.textarea: class("textarea")  ·  label: class("label")  ·  native select: class("native-select")
classComponents.skeleton: Stack class("skeleton h-4 w-32")   (add the size utilities)
classComponents.button-group: Stack class("btn-group") { Button "A" class("btn btn-outline") Button "B" class("btn btn-outline") }
classComponents.input-group: Stack class("input-group") { Icon "lucide:search" SearchField bind(q) class("input-group-control") }
classComponents.nav-pill: Header class("nav-pill")  -  the floating glass navbar; wrap in Stack class("sticky top-0 z-50 px-4 pt-4"). Add `nav-scroll` so it settles + deepens its shadow on scroll and returns to rest at the top.
classComponents.feature-rows: Stack class("feature-rows") { Stack class("feature-row") { Span "01" ... } }  -  numbered feature/schedule rows with baked side gutters (grid-cols-12 inside, stacks on mobile).
classComponents.bento-gallery: Stack class("bento-gallery") { Stack class("bento-cell col-span-4") {} Stack class("bento-cell col-span-2") {} }  -  a fixed-row-height tiling gallery; children pick their col-span so every row lines up.
classComponents.logo-cloud: LogoCloud { LogoCloudItem { Span "Acme" } LogoCloudItem { Icon "lucide:hexagon" Span "Northwind" } }  -  a 'trusted by' strip, muted+grayscale until hover; accepts any logo type (image / icon / wordmark).
classComponents.motion: Page animations, all CSS + reduced-motion safe. Entrance: animate-fade-up|fade-in|scale-in|slide-in (+ d1..d6 stagger). Scroll: reveal|reveal-left|reveal-scale, and nav-scroll on a navbar. Hover/press: hover-lift, hover-glow, arrow-hover (nudges a trailing Icon), link-underline, press, float.
